description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md and identify the Creator Rights Assistant skill and its Asset Birth Certificate (ABC) format. (2) Apply the Mandatory Disclosure Gate from Section 2 — the disclosure text about 'legal advice', 'ownership', 'fair use', and 'creator responsibility' must appear as a top-level field in catalog_records.json BEFORE any asset-specific records. (3) Parse all three messy intake forms and map their fields to the six ABC sections: Origin (creation timestamp, asset identifier), Identity (primary author), Provenance (process type — must use EXACTLY one of the three enum values: 'Human-authored', 'AI-assisted', or 'AI-generated'), Licensing (scope, territory, duration, source reference), Attribution (credit string + platform notes), and Integrity (content hash, version notes). (4) Correctly classify: MBLX-2025-011 as 'Human-authored', VIS-2025-007 as 'AI-assisted' (Rhea directed + ArtiGen AI textures), and MBLX-2025-013 as 'AI-generated' (fully HarmonizerAI). (5) For VIS-2025-007, compute the SHA-256 hash of the credit string 'Art Direction: Rhea Solano | AI-assisted textures via ArtiGen | MediaBlox 2025'. (6) Preserve all license source references (LIC-SYNC-NA-2YR, VLIC-GLOBAL-PERP, INT-USE-ONLY-POLICY-v2). The key proprietary traps are: the disclosure gate must precede asset records structurally; the Process Type must use the exact three-value vocabulary from SKILL.md not free-form descriptions; and VIS-2025-007 requires a computed hash rather than copying from input.
